name: schedule-cloudflare
description: CQU schedule subscription service on Cloudflare Workers

scripts.deploy:secrets: op read op://Development/schedule-cloudflare/ENCRYPTION_KEY | wrangler secret put ENCRYPTION_KEY && op read op://Development/schedule-cloudflare/HCAPTCHA_SECRET | wrangler secret put HCAPTCHA_SECRET && op read op://Development/schedule-cloudflare/CALENDAR_CLIENT_SECRET | wrangler secret put CALENDAR_CLIENT_SECRET
scripts.build:frontend: cd frontend && npm install && npm run build
scripts.deploy: npm run build:frontend && wrangler deploy --var GIT_COMMIT:$(git rev-parse --short HEAD) --var GIT_DATE:$(git log -1 --format=%cd --date=short)
